items.topic: Rigid adult acquired flatfoot and triple arthrodesis
items.destination_intent: 2026 Foot and Ankle OITE teaching page, canonical progressive collapsing foot deformity section upon explicit logging
items.teaching_point_placement: After flexible versus rigid deformity treatment discriminator
items.caption_intent: Exact uploaded Q19: limited subtalar motion with preserved ankle motion supports a hindfoot fusion; supplied radiographs and discussion document severe peritalar subluxation and subfibular impingement. Triple includes subtalar, talonavicular, and calcaneocuboid joints.
